items.objective: P0 — restaurar e estabilizar o acesso por unidade do módulo de Insumos
permitted_actions: preserve immutable rollback and sanitized evidence
prohibited_actions: reopen the incident without a new observed symptom
use this resolved incident to authorize Finance activation
required_evidence: synthetic positive and negative unit-scope journey
items.done_definition: Resolved; retained only for audit and regression observation.

items.objective: Create one immutable Finance staging release from current main and prove its synthetic authenticated import/UI journey.
blockers: current staging Finance Worker/UI attest 32bf3ebb rather than source_main_sha
no synthetic authenticated import/UI journey attested for a current-main single-SHA artifact
permitted_actions: build a candidate from an explicit current main SHA
canonical Finance Worker/UI preview and staging promotion
synthetic authenticated import/UI smoke, canary observation and sanitized evidence capture
prohibited_actions: production grants, users, flags, secrets, data or resources
required_evidence: same SHA in Finance Worker and Finance UI preview/staging promotion evidence
staging migration journal and health/readiness/version evidence
synthetic authenticated import state-machine and UI journey
canary thresholds and rollback availability for that candidate
items.done_definition: A single immutable current-main Finance artifact lineage is healthy in staging and has passed the controlled synthetic authenticated journey; Finance remains experimental and disabled.

items.objective: Prove fresh provider-separated PostgreSQL retrieval and isolated scratch restoration for the Finance recovery gate.
blockers: large PostgreSQL object exceeds the current connector IPC frame limit
alternate provider path is not authorized
permitted_actions: read-only provider metadata and authorization checks
authorized streaming download, integrity verification and scratch restore after access is supplied
prohibited_actions: treat local manifest-matched ciphertext as a new offsite restore
production restore or Finance pilot activation
required_evidence: isolated PostgreSQL scratch restore with sanitized count/checksum and functional evidence
items.done_definition: The provider-separated PostgreSQL object is freshly retrieved, verified and restored in isolation; D1 and runtime-config evidence are retained separately.

items.objective: Prepare, not activate, the Finance pilot package after all staging and recovery gates are current.
permitted_actions: read-only package review and evidence reconciliation
items.done_definition: Named approval is recorded; production activation remains a separate explicit command.

items.objective: Provision isolated Finance production resources through the canonical guarded workflow path.
